headline: JJ Watt lands new deal as full-time CBS lead analyst replacement for Tony Romo
summary: J.J. Watt will be the full-time lead NFL game analyst for CBS Sports, filling the role previously held by Tony Romo.

headline: Sources: Eagles RB Barkley (hamstring) expected to practice, play vs. Cowboys
summary: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley is expected to return to practice Thursday and is in line to play Monday against the Cowboys, sources told NFL Network's Mike Garafolo.

headline: Sources: Nick Sirianni, Mike Vrabel among coaches fined for conduct toward refs
summary: Nick Sirianni and Mike Vrabel have been fined $250,000 for conduct toward officials, sources confirmed to ESPN.
